title_sq: Lokal/bar ne shitje tek kodra e diellit, 200 m nga njesia bashkiake 13 ne Tirane (ID 4171328)
description_sq:
Tek kodra e diellit, 200 m nga njesia bashkiake 13, shitet lokal me hipoteke (aktualisht ne gjendje pune), siperfaqe totale 260 m² (130 m² ambient i brendshem dhe 130 m² verande e mbuluar), ambient lojrash per femijet, 2 tualete, sistem kondicionimi. I gjithe lokali eshte i kompletuar me banakun, tavolinat, dhomen e lojrave per femijet, ambient i jashtem qe aktualisht shfrytezohet per te vendosur disa tavolina. Lokali ndodhet ne katin perdhe te nje pallati te ri pjese e nje kompleksi (i vetmi lokak ne kompleks).
Cmimi 320000 Euro
title_en: Bar/bar for sale at the hill of the sun, 200 m from municipal unit 13 in Tirana (ID 4171328)
description_en: On the hill of the sun, 200 m from municipal unit 13, premises for sale with mortgage (currently in working condition), total area 260 m² (130 m² indoor area and 130 m² covered veranda), playground for children, 2 toilets, air conditioning system. The entire bar is complete with counters, tables, a playroom for children, an outdoor area that is currently used to place several tables. The bar is located on the ground floor of a new building, part of a complex (the only bar in the complex). The price is 320,000 Euros
